name: fynns-ui-agent-interfaces
title: Consumer-agent interfaces for @fynns/ui
description: Two stable entry points for agents in consumer repos: a documentation catalog (every natural-language doc in this package) and a technical API for lightweight custom CodeBlock highlighting of app-owned languages. Design language SoT is docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md — not slim AGENTS.md. Props lookup: node scripts/api.mjs <Name>.

Machine-readable twin of AGENT_INTERFACES.md.
Design language SoT index (Hard rules / catalog / density chapters).
OpenCode resident summary + token discipline — not the full design-system SoT.
Install via zero-token sibling file: + greenfield skeleton + primitive-by-job table (human contract).
Machine contract for consume:install / check / api.
AGENTS.md template written into consumer apps (OpenCode / small local models).
Pasteable always-on consumer Cursor rule (detailed treaty).
Failure-mode slug index → sandbox / DESIGN_SYSTEM.
Public API purge / migration table for deleted symbols and recent behavioral breaks.
Shell / inspector / catalog / live-draft jank rules for core and consumers.
LM Studio + OpenCode setup and token budgets for the local Qwen3.8-27B profile.
ChatComposer multiline geometry authority (read only for Chat work).
Chat ARIA parity research target (read only for Chat a11y work).
User-message edit UX research target (not in core yet).

Package overview, sandbox, consume pointers.

apiLookup.summary: node scripts/api.mjs <Name> prints the public signature + props type (JSDoc stripped) of any @fynns/ui export; --list groups all public symbols by file; --search <regex>; --tokens <regex> [--values] lists --fynns-* names from theme.css.

codeHighlight.summary: Zero-dep CodeBlock highlighting. Built-ins (ts/js/py/cpp/css/json/xml/html/bash/markdown) plus consumer-registered SimpleHighlightProfile for line-command DSLs. label is chrome only — agents must pass language (or profile) explicitly; omitted/unknown → plain mono.
codeHighlight.note: Core does not ship app-specific DSL languages. Consumers register their own command/keyword lists. Never treat CodeBlock label filename as a language detector — see AGENT_INTERFACES.md.
